end.summary: Recognised halves, thirds, and quarters as equal parts in shapes.
end.parentNote: Asha practised equal shares, naming fractions, finding a fraction of a collection, and comparing unit fractions. Nisha explained that equal parts must be the same size and correctly identified halves, thirds, and quarters in most shape examples. They initially mixed up finding one-third of a collection, but later used division into equal groups to reach 1/3 of 9 = 3 and 1/3 of 15 = 5; teach-back was not yet complete. At home, use 9 or 15 small objects and ask Nisha to make three equal groups before naming one-third.
